context_for_next_testing_agent: Pricing mode detection logic fully tested. Key behavior: simple math (Qty×Price=Total) is tried FIRST. If it passes, pricing_mode=case_price and $/LB=CasePrice/CaseWT. Only when simple fails AND weight math (Qty×CaseWT×Price=Total) passes, pricing_mode=weight_based and $/LB=Price. Test invoices: WM-001 (weight-based items), Performance Food Group (case-price items with derived $/LB).
